commands.command:
cat > /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance <<'EOF'
SHELL=/bin/sh
PATH=/sbin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin
15 2 * * * root /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1
EOF
chmod 0644 /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance
cat /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance

systemctl reload crond 2>&1 || systemctl restart crond; systemctl is-active crond; sh -c '/usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1'; cat /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log; ls -l /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
